summary: Tightens the temporary GitHub Actions lane-unlocker bridge with read-only Rust/Buck2 checks for least-privilege token permissions, no long-lived GitHub secrets, and disabled checkout credential persistence.

facets.F1_scope: P00 GitHub Actions shadow bridge hardening; workflow checkout settings, Rust bridge checker, tests, bridge spec, repo-hygiene backlog status, and audit evidence changed.
facets.F2_source_authority: specs/github-lane-unlocker-bridge.json, specs/repo-hygiene-automation.json, GitHub Actions security hardening, automatic token authentication, actions/checkout, and Buck2/Prow authority posture.
F3_tests: RED: rustc --edition=2024 -D warnings scripts/tests/github_lane_unlocker_bridge_check.rs --test ... failed before guard with workflow_rejects_checkout_credentials_persistence and workflow_rejects_broad_or_write_permissions
buck2 build //:github-lane-unlocker-bridge-check //:repo-hygiene-automation-check //:buck2-authority-policy-check; BUILD SUCCEEDED, Build ID 99f0f3e1-e0e7-41d1-87a0-c1e125eb3ab7
facets.F4_security: Workflow now disables checkout credential persistence and the Rust checker rejects broad/write token permissions plus long-lived GitHub secret consumption in the temporary bridge workflow.
facets.F5_privacy: No new secret or data collection surface; the workflow explicitly rejects secrets.* use.
facets.F6_reliability: New regression tests cover missing checkout credential hardening, write-all/content-write token escalation, and long-lived secret use.
facets.F7_operability: GitHub Actions remains shadow/temporary; no live branch protection, Kubernetes, or native oya-ci authority mutation is claimed.
facets.F8_performance: No extra runtime jobs or fanout load; checks run in the existing Rust/Buck2 bridge gate.
facets.F9_maintainability: Centralizes workflow hardening policy in assert-github-lane-unlocker-bridge.rs and records source-backed spec fields rather than scattering ad-hoc shell checks.
facets.F10_compatibility: Preserves actions/checkout@v6, Node24 opt-in, Buck2 fanout lanes, required shadow context, and dry-run CD bridge shape.
facets.F11_supply_chain: No new dependencies; reduces credential exposure in checkout steps.
